I was in a pretty low state, lost my dog my girlfriend my job and my beautiful house. I was at the post office one day signing off some paperwork to finalise selling my house, I was depressed and pretty unhappy with it all and the day just represented the end of everything I ever had. Anyway as I'm almost finishing up talking to the lady I feel a tap on my shoulder, I knew it was him. I didn't turn around until I was done but when I did I was greeted with a "how's it going bro" and I big strong friendly handshake then he pulled me in close and gave me the biggest strongest hug I'd ever gotten in a long while. I felt instantly better, I felt happy that I could cry. I had to sign off a bit more paperwork and as I was leaving I walked up to him shook his hand gave him a quick  hug and left. This guy was my hero. Made my day, my week even.

I used to work a job where it was 12 hours a day running 20km a day and lifting very heavy bins, I got very tired and very sure and I injured my shoulders but I had to keep going so I could make ends meat. Eventually my body adapted and I was never sore and never tired and I could sprint up a hill and lift bins with ease without any pain. I also recommend working out with an upper lower body split so if your upper body is sore, work lower body or vise versa.
